verdict.line: You lose if you let Volibear stack free W procs and Q you into stuns with E poking behind it, but you win the long game since Cho'Gath holds a 53.8% head-to-head over 184 games once Rupture starts landing.

brief.thesis: Volibear has the better early trade thanks to Q (Thundering Smash) closing distance and stunning on a 12-10.5s cooldown while W (Frenzied Maul) punishes you for standing still, but Cho'Gath's own trade tools - Rupture's knock-up and Vorpal Spikes stacking on every auto - scale harder per level and flip the lane once Feral Scream is up on its 13s cooldown to answer his all-in.

theirWindow.when: Q (Thundering Smash) off cooldown, he's walking at you
theirWindow.what: He is about to dash in and stun the first thing he hits, then chain W (Frenzied Maul) twice for the heal-back bonus damage. Back off or have Rupture ready to punish the dash.

yourWindow.when: his Q is on cooldown (just used it)
yourWindow.what: Walk up and farm with E (Vorpal Spikes) procs, or threaten Q (Rupture) into W (Feral Scream) since he has no stun to interrupt your combo for the next 10-12 seconds.

Sustained magic damage and the omnivamp keep you ahead in extended trades where his W heal-back would otherwise outlast you.

runes.keystoneWhy: The 55.2%-picked page — Hail of Blades front-loads your attack speed so Vorpal Spikes procs stack faster than he can land his first Q, winning the all-in trade before his stun resets.

summoners.why: The top pick at 58.4% and best win rate (49.3%) of the options — Teleport lets you reset after losing the early Q trades and still scale into your 9-13 power spike window.

playing.title: Bait his Q then punish
playing.detail: Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) stuns the first thing he hits on a 12-10.5s cooldown. Hold Rupture until right after he uses it, when he has no stun to stop your combo.

playing.title: Track his W stacks mid-trade
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul marks you on first hit and deals bonus damage plus heals him on the second cast. Disengage after the first W instead of standing for the follow-up.

playing.title: Farm with Vorpal Spikes, not autos alone
playing.detail: Every auto triggers E for free damage in front of you on a 0.5s cooldown. Last-hit with autos rather than Q to keep Rupture ready for his engage.

playing.title: Save Feral Scream for his all-in
playing.detail: W silences on a 13s cooldown, shutting down his W heal-back and any follow-up ability. Hold it until he commits Q, not as a poke tool.

playing.title: Feast priority from level 6
playing.detail: R deals true damage and grows you on a kill, max 6 stacks. Use it to finish trades he thinks he's winning, since the true damage ignores his passive-fueled resistances.

playing.title: Respect his E poke range
playing.detail: Sky Splitter hits 1200 range and shields him if he's in the blast. Don't stand in open lane to farm when it's up — his cooldown is 16s, so track it like his Q.

playing.title: Play around his Stormbringer post-6
playing.detail: His ultimate leaps to a location, slows, damages, and can disable your tower temporarily. From level 9+ onward, don't overextend alone once he has it up — the long base cooldown (160s dropping to 110s) means early uses are costly to him.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning connecting them to ability cooldowns and trade windows is my own analysis.
